d: Short, sleek ash blonde hair is styled in a neat side-parted sweep. The sharp, narrow eyes are a pale icy blue with a stern, focused expression on a mature, adult face marked by a diagonal scar over the right eyebrow. A lean build is dressed in a formal ensemble consisting of a white collared shirt, a black tie with a gold hexagonal clip, a dark navy waistcoat, and a heavy overcoat featuring a voluminous black faux-fur collar. A single white glove covers the hand holding a glass of amber liquid.
